description:
Hold-to-talk dictation for Windows. Hold a key, speak, and clean text is typed into any app.

Talkative is a free, open-source dictation app for Windows that lives in the system tray.
Hold a hotkey (Right Ctrl by default) while you speak, or tap it to start and again to stop: your words are transcribed, cleaned up
(filler words and repeats removed, punctuation added) and pasted wherever your cursor is, in any app.
A second hotkey dictates code and terminal commands (git, dotnet, npm, SQL and more) as runnable text.
Choose Cloud processing for speed on any PC, or Local processing that runs fully offline.
